positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Waymo is developing the world's most experienced driver and offers ride-hailing service in several major cities. Take one today!

I work on the Simulation team to help keep you safe!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Applied Intuition develops software tools that help companies — primarily in the automotive, trucking, and defense industries — to develop, test, and validate autonomous systems and vehicle software.

As an engineer on the Map Toolset team, I was responsible for the full-stack development of tools for 3D map editing and analysis.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Argo AI developed a self-driving system for autonomous vehicles, including the necessary software, hardware, and mapping infrastructure, in partnership with major automakers. It was acquired by Ford in 2022 to form Latitude AI.

As a member of the Map Services & Pipeline team, I developed and maintained critical data pipelines for high-definition 3D maps used by autonomous vehicles

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
The R&D organization at GM develops and productionizes impactful technologies for the benefit of customers.

I developed a publish/subscribe framework for in-network processing and created a vehicle-oriented Android application to demonstrate the framework’s capabilities.

positions.title: Financial Software Developer
positions.description:
Bloomberg is a global financial data, software, and media company that provides real-time market data, analytics, and news to financial professionals through its flagship product, the Bloomberg Terminal, and various media outlets.

As a financial software developer for the Bloomberg Terminal, I developed and maintained a high-performance electronic trading platform for Foreign Exchange (FX).

educations.schoolName: The Cooper Union for the Advancement of Science and Art
